effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Sea Beast], [Plesiosaur], [Beastkin] or [X Antibody] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon can't attack until the end of their turn.
